# Wazwan Way

> Wazwan Way (wazwanway.com) is a premium guide to Kashmiri cuisine and travel: the 36-course Wazwan feast, authentic dishes, trusted restaurants in Srinagar and the Kashmir valley, traditional recipes, offbeat destinations, and scenic drives. Content is curated and locally researched.

Wazwan is the traditional multi-course Kashmiri feast prepared by master chefs called Wazas, served on a shared copper platter called the trami. Wazwan Way documents its dishes, history, etiquette, and where to experience it authentically.

## Core Guides

- [What is Wazwan?](https://wazwanway.com/kashmiri-food/wazwan/guide/what-is-wazwan): The 36-course feast explained — courses, sequence, and meaning
- [Wazwan Dishes Explained](https://wazwanway.com/kashmiri-food/wazwan/guide/dishes-explained): Every major trami dish from Rista to Gushtaba
- [History of Wazwan](https://wazwanway.com/history): 700 years of Kashmir's royal culinary heritage, from Central Asian origins to today
- [Wazwan Cost Guide](https://wazwanway.com/kashmiri-food/wazwan/guide/cost-guide): What a Wazwan actually costs at restaurants and weddings
- [Kashmiri Food Overview](https://wazwanway.com/kashmiri-food): Wazwan, bakery, beverages, and street food traditions

## Dishes & Restaurants

- [All Kashmiri Dishes](https://wazwanway.com/dishes): 90+ dishes with history, spice levels, and where to try them
- [Rogan Josh](https://wazwanway.com/dishes/rogan-josh): Kashmir's signature lamb curry
- [Restaurants](https://wazwanway.com/restaurants): Curated authentic Wazwan restaurants — Ahdoos, Mughal Darbar, Shamyana, Clove

## Travel

- [Rare Destinations](https://wazwanway.com/destinations): Offbeat Kashmir — Gurez, Bangus, Lolab, Doodhpathri, and more
- [Scenic Drives](https://wazwanway.com/scenic-drives): Road-trip routes with conditions and elevation profiles

## Journal

- [Blog](https://wazwanway.com/blog): Long-form stories — saffron, breads, spice blends, etiquette
